title: Kyber bin dey VivaTech
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
html:
Kyber for VivaTech 2026: Four days of demo, media coverage and correct tok-tok

VivaTech 2026 don end, and e na one wey pipo no go forget quick-quick. For four hot days, di Kyber team bin dey ground for di biggest tech event for Europe, dey show our real-time infrastructure technology to engineers, founders, investors and innovators wey come from different corners of di world.

Na di full gist of wetin happen be dis, who we tok to, and why dis edition mata well-well for us.

Why Kyber go VivaTech 2026

VivaTech na where di tok-tok wey really mata dey happen. Robot, drone, XR, AI agents, sovereign infrastructure, real-time systems, all dis tins no be small corner matter again. Na dem dey for centre of where tech dey go, and di 10th anniversary edition of VivaTech show am pass any oda time.

For Kyber, to dey der na normal step. We dey build ultra-low latency real-time infrastructure for dis Physical AI era, di technology wey dey allow pipo control robot, drone, XR systems and machine wey dey work by demsef from far place, and dem go respond almost sharp-sharp. VivaTech na exactly where di pipo wey need dat kain technology dey come to see wetin dey next.

We set up for di booth of our partners and padi dem for Scaleway, for Hall 7.3, Booth 3F10, and we spend di whole week dey run live demo back-to-back for visitors wey come see Kyber as e dey work.

Jean-Baptiste Kempf for VivaTech: for stage, for TV, and for newspaper

For stage wit Inria

Jean-Baptiste Kempf, di pesin wey found Kyber and one of di main developers wey dey behind VLC, climb stage for VivaTech to give one tok wey dem title “From Coding to Prompting” (From to write code reach to give AI instruction), togeda wit Inria, di French national research institute for digital science and technology.

Di tok face two of di biggest questions wey di tech industry dey face today:

Wetin AI mean for engineering team dem? As large language models don fit write code wey good reach production level, di work of developer dey change from di root. Companies still dey recruit engineers di same way? Dem even still dey recruit dem at all?

Wetin go happen to di tools and infrastructure wey we take build evritin? Software forges, dev pipelines, cloud infrastructure, pipo dey reason all of dem again as di way wey we dey build software dey change from inside.

Dis no be questions wey pipo just dey imagine. For founder like Jean-Baptiste, wey don spend many decades dey build important open-source infrastructure, na real-life questions wey e dey face everyday.

BFM Business, Tech & Co

On Monday, 22 June, Jean-Baptiste Kempf join François Sorel for BFM Business for di daily Tech & Co show, wit Thomas Serval (CEO of Baracoda), Jean Schmitt (President of Jolt Capital), and Hugo Borensztein (co-founder and President of Omi).

Di panel review di 10th edition of VivaTech: how Jeff Bezos show face for di event wey evribodi dey tok about, di innovations wey sweet dem pass for di ones wey dem display, and wetin di future be for dis important European tech event.

Watch di replay for BFM Business

BSMART 4Change

Jean-Baptiste Kempf still appear for BSMART 4Change, wey add more media presence for Kyber during di event week.

Watch di replay for YouTube

TechCrunch

Kyber story catch di eye of TechCrunch, and dem publish one special report on Jean-Baptiste Kempf and di technology wey e dey build, dey follow di road from VLC, di free video player wey pipo dey use pass for di whole world, reach real-time infrastructure for robot and physical AI systems.

Read di TechCrunch article: “Im make your free video player run smooth. Now e dey do di same tin for robot.”

Four days of demo and business tok-tok

Apart from di media moments, wetin really define di week na di tok-tok wey happen for di floor.

We run live demo nonstop for di whole four days, dey give visitors chance to see wit dia own eye wetin Kyber real-time stack fit do: video, audio, sensor data and control inputs, all of dem dey move wit latency wey no pass single-digit millisecond across cloud, hybrid and edge environments.

Di tok-tok cover evritin: partners wey fit join us dey look how dem go take integrate, customers wey wan understand how Kyber go fit enter dia stack, founders dey compare notes, and engineers dey ask di hard technical questions. Dat kain mix, as e full and as e get different-different pipo, na im make VivaTech different from any oda event.

E also happen for one important time for us: Kyber just announce seed funding of $5 million, wit Lightspeed as lead investor and Kima and Ovni Capital follow put hand. Di announcement bring interest from exactly di kain players wey we bin dey hope to meet for di event.

We dey say thank you

Correct thank you to evribodi wey stop for di booth to gist, test our demos, or just ask questions. And special shoutout to Scaleway as dem welcome di Kyber team for dia booth for di whole four days, good partners dey make difference.

We go see for VivaTech 2027

Di 10th edition of VivaTech get power, e carry pipo from all over di world, and e full wit real business. We come show wetin we dey build, meet di pipo wey dey shape di industry, and prove say deep tech wey dem make for France dey alive well-well.

Mission don complete.

We go come back. We go see next year 💎

You wan sabi more about Kyber? Visit kyber.tech or reach us for contact@kyber.tech.

Companies wey dis article mention

Scaleway: French cloud provider wey dey offer sovereign infrastructure wey fit last, including compute, storage and managed services.

Inria: France national research institute for digital science and technology, wey dey focus on mathematics, computer science and how pipo dey take dem work.

BFM Business: French TV channel wey dey run 24/7 and dey cover economy, finance and tech news.

BSMART: French TV channel for business and innovation, wey dey cover entrepreneurship, technology and sustainable transformation.

TechCrunch: Top global media outlet wey dey cover startups, technology and venture capital.

Baracoda: IoT and health tech company wey dey develop connected devices and smart solutions for workplace and healthcare industry.

Jolt Capital: European growth equity fund wey dey focus on deep tech and B2B technology companies.

Omi: Wearable platform wey AI dey power, wey dey help wit real-time memory, productivity and personal AI assistance.

Lightspeed: Global venture capital firm wey dey invest for early and growth-stage startups for consumer, enterprise and deep tech.

Kima Ventures: Early-stage VC fund wey base for Paris, one of di seed investors wey dey active pass for Europe.

Ovni Capital: French venture capital fund wey dey invest for bold tech startups wey dey set new standard for dia category.
